errors.evidence: The description states that the blue line (SepLLM, n=128) decreases to roughly 2.6 by ~100k iterations. However, the plot shows this line is visibly below the 2.6 gridline at this point, with a value closer to 2.55. The orange line is at approximately 2.6 at this point, so the description incorrectly equates the values of the two lines.
